authority.scope: Current Autodesk header group codes and descriptions.
Secondary reproduction of the attributed R14-to-R2000 revision history lists HYPERLINKBASE, CEPSNTYPE, and PSVPSCALE as new header variables.

change: Omit these three generated fields for pre-R2000 output and refuse any explicit source value, including aliases, before writing. R2000 and later output stays unchanged. Reuse the same legacy source-presence guard for the earlier lineweight fields. LibreCAD discloses omission of its paper-scale default of 1; non-default scale still refuses without replacing the destination.

validation.transaction: PASS: full-adapter ASCII/binary controls preserve destination and retry for the three scalar fields and eight previously guarded fields.
validation.consumerSystem: PASS: 4941 assertions in 54 linetype cases; new R12/R14 test covers default paper-scale loss report, non-default refusal, destination preservation, corrected retry and unchanged graphic.
validation.image: PASS: imported-common and two-layer matrices with rollback/retry controls.
validation.qualification: PASS: clean-checkout implementation digest, required-test, inventory and workflow contracts.

limits: Other post-R14 header fields and explicit source values require their own representability or disclosed-loss policy.
Native R14 application behavior, broader graph semantics and final platform qualification remain open.
